claims.quote: The Deccan rita, Rita kuturnee, is a bagrid catfish from large river systems in India, growing to around 260 mm SL.

regions.name: Krishna
regions.quote: Asia: Peninsular India from Deccan rivers up to the Krishna river system, including the Kaveri, Krishna and Tungabhadra, and the states of Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka.
